text:
lucy: quick note — users keep opening shared saved queries and the model they expect is different. it silently falls back and folks file tickets.
dan: is this happening only across routes or also across regions/tenants?
lucy: mainly route-to-route. alice saves a view on /routes/ingest pinned to `redwood-opt:2q`. bob opens the same saved view on /routes/transform and sees `redwood-opt:1q` with no helpful explanation.
infra-bot: FYI model availability varies by region, quantization, and entitlement. automatic fallback is expected behavior.
rachel: proposal: surface both the requested_model and applied_model in the API response plus a `fallback_reason` string. saved-view object should optionally include `routing_hint` and a `portability` enum: `portable` or `locked`.
kevin: small API sketch please.
rachel: snippet: `{ id: "sv_123", filters: "...", requested_model: "redwood-opt:2q", routing_hint: "region=us-east-1;quota=dedicated", portability: "portable" }` (routing_hint optional).
amanda: UX idea: pill in the header: "Saved with redwood-opt:2q (unavailable here)". expanding shows: "Opened with: redwood-opt:1q — reason: region mismatch" and actions: [Open fallback] [Request access] [See details]. keeps it discoverable. :bulb:
dan: ACL note: if portability == locked and opener lacks entitlement, server should return a clear error payload (403-like) with `error_code=locked_model_required`. portable views must never block.
lucy: telemetry ask — track `saved_view.open` with fields view_id, opener_id, requested_model, applied_model, used_fallback=true|false, fallback_reason. also `saved_view.shared_open` when opened from a different route.
infra-bot: will emit events. for now keep fields as strings to avoid pipeline churn. will include `entitlement_status` and `route_region` strings.
kevin: backwards compat: routing_hint optional. old saved views treat portability as portable. clients should render both `requested_model` and `applied_model` when present.
rachel: rollout plan: feature flag `sv.model_portability_v1` at 10% orgs. monitor fallback rate, support ticket delta, and click-through on "Request access".
amanda: i’ll mock the pill + details modal and a locked-view error state tomorrow.
lucy: thanks — i'll open the ticket with API sketch, telemetry fields, and mock links. tagging @kevin @infra-bot for the spec and event contracts.
kevin: will add a swagger diff today and note deterministic fallback rules.
infra-bot: impl note: validate requested_model format, map to available_variants for route, deterministically pick applied_model, emit telemetry.
lucy: awesome. small follow-up — wording: avoid implying a bug. use "Not available here" vs "Unavailable". :thumbsup:
